headline: Honda brings a new battery countermeasure to Las Vegas
body: Honda found the cause of Lance Stroll's Brazil battery failure and has fitted another countermeasure for Las Vegas. Chief engineer Shintaro Orihara said it will probably not fully prevent a repeat, and that the battery structure will be updated for 2027.

headline: Bottas stays at Cadillac for 2027
body: Cadillac has kept Valtteri Bottas alongside Sergio Perez for 2027 rather than promoting test driver Colton Herta. That completes next year's 22-car grid. Reserve and test drivers will be announced in due course.
